tagline: Improving everyday life for billions of people through technology
hero_kpi_rationale: Core Headline Earnings Per Share (HEPS) is the primary operational performance indicator after taxes, reflecting profitable growth from consolidated operations and holdings like Tencent. It is the central KPI used by management to measure value creation.

kpis.name: Earnings Per Share (core)
kpis.explanation: After-tax earnings adjusted for non-recurring items, divided by the number of shares outstanding.
kpis.description: Core HEPS increased significantly due to improved profitability in Ecommerce operations and Tencent contribution.
kpis.signal: Core earnings growth +95% YoY, key valuation driver

kpis.name: Ecommerce consolidated trading profit
kpis.explanation: Operating profit generated by the group's consolidated Ecommerce operations.
kpis.description: Consolidated Ecommerce turned profitable at $38M after a $413M loss in the prior year, driven by iFood and OLX.
kpis.signal: Ecommerce profitability achieved, one year ahead of target

kpis.name: Total revenue
kpis.description: Revenue increased driven by strong performance in Food Delivery and Classifieds segments.
kpis.signal: Double-digit growth sustained by iFood and OLX

kpis.name: Net interest income
kpis.explanation: Difference between interest revenue and interest expenses.
kpis.description: The group generated net interest income of $428M driven by higher interest rates and substantial cash holdings.
kpis.signal: Positive net interest income for the first time due to elevated rates

kpis.name: Available cash
kpis.explanation: Liquidity and short-term investments held by the group.
kpis.description: The group maintains strong cash balance of $16B, with approximately $8B available for new investments.
kpis.signal: High cash balance to fund investments and share buybacks

kpis.name: Share buyback
kpis.explanation: Total value of shares repurchased under the ongoing program since June 2022.
kpis.description: Since June 2022, the buyback program has reduced float by 21% and enhanced shareholder value. Cumulative repurchase: 318.2M shares for $17.1B.
kpis.signal: $17.1B in buybacks, generating 8.2% accretion to intrinsic value per share

kpis.name: Dividend received from Tencent
kpis.explanation: Dividend received by Prosus from its Tencent holding.
kpis.description: Tencent dividend reached $759M in FY2024, with an additional $1.0B already received for 2025.
kpis.signal: Growing Tencent contribution via dividends, primary source of operating cash flow

kpis.name: Total headcount
kpis.explanation: Number of employees in consolidated companies.
kpis.description: Employee count is not disclosed in the source document.

kpis.name: Generative AI impact on Edtech
kpis.explanation: Effect of generative AI adoption on revenue and strategy in the Edtech segment.
kpis.description: Generative AI slowed Edtech revenue growth, but Stack Overflow leveraged the group's internal AI capabilities to improve its value proposition with early positive results. Corrective actions were implemented to improve profitability.
kpis.signal: Growth slowdown mitigated by profitability improvement via internal AI

ai_positioning.summary: Prosus integrates generative AI across portfolio companies, notably through internal tools to enhance products such as at Stack Overflow. Focus is on optimizing existing offerings rather than breakthrough AI initiatives.
evidence: Stack Overflow leveraged the group's internal AI capabilities to improve its value proposition with early positive results
Generative AI adoption cited as a factor affecting the Edtech segment but corrective measures were implemented
The group develops proprietary AI tools for its holdings, particularly in Edtech
